text_block_list.text:
One day, while training hard with our 
sights set on the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hm? It sounds rather lively over there. 
Could it be that they're having a 
barbecue?

Indeed, a crowd of people who appeared to 
be reporters had gathered. Looking closer—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Your run in the race the other day was 
truly magnificent!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"To think she would put on such a run 
under conditions where no one would blame 
her for losing!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine even if we can't win"? —No such 
race exists.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I embody ideals in every arena as the 
"Empress." I have simply done what must be 
done.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Impressive as always! How utterly 
terrifying... I mean, reliable!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is that all for the interview? If so, 
excuse me. I cannot afford to waste 
training time.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Aaah, please wait! Air Groove-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so popular! As expected of Air 
Groove!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
As a friend, it's a nose-high-five, 
right~!

Lately, Air Groove had been producing 
stellar results across multiple GⅠ races.
choice_data_list: I can't afford to lose, huh.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes! Even if you're my friend, I won't 
hand over Horse Girl of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay, time to re-try training! Focusing up 
starting now! I will run seriously, yes!
choice_data_list: (Huh? I have a bad feeling about this...)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, who's that over there!? Howdy, 
Suzuka!!"

Taiki Shuttle immediately lost her focus, 
and I hurriedly chased after her.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, are you training? Then let's do it 
together!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...? But, hmm...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, you're running in the Mile 
Championship, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! I'm going to go face off against 
the Senior Class Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Then we cannot train together.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Noooo!? Whhyyyy!? Why would you, Suzuka!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You know, the truth is I've decided to 
enter too. The Mile Championship—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, really!? Suzuka is running the Mile!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm... right now, a bit... How should 
I put it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—I've been thinking a little about my own 
running.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Suzuka's running, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right. That's why... in various races, I 
want to try out all sorts of things.

Come to think of it, Silence Suzuka pulled 
off an unbelievable runaway lead in her 
recent race against Air Groove as well.

"Was this also one of the explorations she 
was talking about...?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Just a bit more. I feel like I'm right 
on the verge of grasping it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So next time, in the Mile Championship, I 
want to feel the speed of a shorter race."

I understood what Silence Suzuka was 
thinking.

Either way, on our end, if they're 
running, we have no choice but to stay on 
guard...!
choice_data_list:
Rivals aren't just in the Senior class, 
huh

Rivals aren't just in the Senior class, 
you know

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! I won't lose, Suzuka! I'm not 
giving up number one!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Indeed. I won't lose either.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, I'm getting all fired up! Let's 
keep this momentum going and get to 
trainiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Suzuka!! First, one full lap at 
total power, YES!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, WHAT!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Taiki, were you listening...? They 
said you can't train with your opponent—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No problem! I'll run, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You've gotta be kidding me~?!

And so, it was decided that Silence Suzuka 
would also enter the Mile Championship, 
which was Taiki Shuttle's target race.
